task.title: Build RelayAI MVP - AI-powered relationship outreach tool
task.description: Build a complete single-file HTML/JS application called RelayAI. This is a sales relationship automation tool. Features required: 1) Login screen with hardcoded credentials (admin/relayai2024). 2) Contact dashboard showing all contacts with name, company, tier (A/B/C), last contact date, days overdue, and status. 3) AI-powered message generation - clicking a contact generates a personalized outreach message using their name, company, tier, and any notes. Messages must feel genuine and human, not templated. 4) Approve/edit/send flow - rep sees the draft, can edit inline, then approve. Approved messages log under that contact. 5) Activity log per contact showing all past outreach with timestamps. 6) Dashboard summary showing: total contacts, overdue by tier, recent activity. 7) Add/edit contact form with fields: name, company, phone, email, tier (A/B/C), touch frequency in days, notes. 8) Mobile responsive design. 9) localStorage for all data persistence. 10) Clean professional dark theme UI. The AI message generation should call the Anthropic API directly from the frontend using fetch() to https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages with model claude-sonnet-4-20250514. Use a placeholder API key variable at the top of the file called ANTHROPIC_API_KEY that can be easily replaced.

affected_sections: html_structure - login screen, dashboard, contact forms, activity logs
css_styling - dark theme, mobile responsive, professional UI
javascript_state_management - localStorage for contacts and messages
authentication_logic - hardcoded login with session management
contact_crud_operations - add, edit, view, filter contacts
ai_integration - Anthropic API calls for message generation
message_workflow - draft, edit, approve, send flow
activity_logging - timestamp all outreach per contact
data.approach: Build single-file HTML application with embedded CSS and JavaScript. Structure: 1) Define ANTHROPIC_API_KEY constant at top. 2) Create authentication layer with localStorage session token. 3) Build contact data model with fields (id, name, company, phone, email, tier, touchFrequency, lastContact, notes, messages[]). 4) Implement localStorage wrapper for CRUD operations. 5) Create UI sections (login, dashboard, contact detail, add/edit forms) using vanilla JS DOM manipulation or template literals. 6) Build dashboard with summary cards calculating overdue contacts by tier using date math. 7) Implement AI message generation function that calls Anthropic API with structured prompt including contact context. 8) Create message approval flow with contenteditable div for inline editing. 9) Add activity log component showing chronological message history. 10) Apply CSS Grid/Flexbox for responsive layout with mobile-first breakpoints. 11) Use dark theme variables (CSS custom properties) for consistent styling. 12) Implement view routing via data attributes or hash navigation without page reloads.
risks: API key exposure - storing Anthropic key in frontend JavaScript is insecure for production
CORS issues - Anthropic API may require backend proxy to avoid browser CORS restrictions
localStorage limits - large contact lists or message histories may exceed 5-10MB quota
No data validation - direct localStorage manipulation without schema validation risks data corruption
Session security - hardcoded credentials with localStorage token lacks true authentication
Date calculations - timezone handling and DST transitions may cause incorrect overdue calculations
AI response variability - generated messages may be inconsistent quality without retry logic
Mobile keyboard - inline editing may have poor UX on mobile devices
No error boundaries - network failures or API errors could break entire app state
Browser compatibility - modern JS features may not work in older browsers
preserve: none - starting from minimal placeholder, no existing patterns to preserve
data.estimated_complexity: high - requires implementing authentication, CRUD operations, external API integration, responsive UI, state management, date calculations, and multi-view navigation in single file without frameworks

issues: API key is hardcoded as empty string - should have a more visible placeholder comment indicating where to replace it
No error handling for localStorage quota exceeded scenarios
The AI message generation prompt could be more sophisticated to better handle different tier types and relationship stages
No loading state or spinner while AI message is being generated - user might click multiple times
Contact form validation is basic - email format not validated, phone format not validated
Days overdue calculation doesn't account for timezone differences which could cause edge case bugs
No confirmation dialog when deleting contacts - could lead to accidental deletions
The 'Send' button in message approval doesn't actually send anything (no email integration), which might confuse users expecting real sending functionality
data.feedback:
Overall excellent implementation that meets all core requirements. The code is well-structured, implements all 10 required features, uses localStorage properly, has a clean dark theme, and is mobile responsive. The AI integration with Anthropic API is correctly implemented using fetch(). 

Strengths:
- Complete feature set matching all requirements
- Clean, maintainable single-file architecture
- Proper data persistence with localStorage
- Good UI/UX with tier-based color coding
- Activity logging works correctly
- Dashboard metrics are accurate
- Mobile responsive design implemented

Recommended improvements:
1. Add a loading spinner/disabled state when 'Generate AI Message' is clicked to prevent double-submissions
2. Add confirmation dialog for contact deletion to prevent accidents
3. Enhance the API key placeholder with a clear comment like `// REPLACE WITH YOUR ANTHROPIC API KEY`
4. Add basic email/phone format validation in the contact form
5. Consider adding a note that 'Send' logs the message but doesn't actually send email (or implement real sending)
6. Add try-catch around localStorage operations for quota exceeded scenarios

Minor code quality notes:
- Some functions are quite long and could be broken down for better maintainability
- Consider extracting the AI prompt template to a separate function for easier customization

The implementation is production-ready for an MVP with the caveat that the API key needs to be added and users understand 'Send' is logging only.

concerns: Login error message doesn't have role='alert' for screen readers
Modal close buttons (×) lack accessible labels - screen reader users won't know what they close
Contact tier badges use color alone to convey meaning (no icon or text differentiator)
Loading spinner during API call has no aria-live announcement
Days overdue displayed as negative numbers might be confusing (e.g., '-5 days')
Empty states (no contacts, no activity log) could be more visually prominent
Inline editing in message draft has no visual indicator that content is editable
No keyboard shortcut hints (e.g., 'Esc to close modal')
suggestions: Add toast notifications for success actions (contact saved, message sent)
Consider adding a search/filter feature for contact list as it grows
Add confirmation dialog before deleting a contact
Show character count on message textarea to help reps gauge length
Add a 'Mark as contacted' quick action without generating AI message
Consider adding avatar placeholders or initials for contacts
Add keyboard shortcuts (e.g., 'n' for new contact, '/' for search)
Show API key status indicator (valid/invalid/missing) on dashboard
blocking_issues: API key is exposed in frontend code - major security vulnerability. Should use backend proxy or at minimum warn users about exposure risk
No error handling when API key is missing/invalid - app will fail silently
Modal backgrounds don't trap focus - keyboard users can tab to elements behind modals
Form submit buttons don't disable during submission - can cause duplicate submissions
